name: Kids Educational
description: Fun, colorful learning videos for young children (ages 3-8)
image_style: children's picture book illustration, bright cheerful colors, soft rounded shapes, flat cartoon style, simple clean background, cute and friendly, high quality digital art
negative_prompt: scary, dark, creepy, realistic photo, violent, complex background
mascot_look: a cute friendly orange fox wearing a little green scarf
script_system_prompt: You write scripts for short educational videos for young children. Your scripts are fun, surprising, and keep kids watching from the first second. You always reply with valid JSON only.
script_user_template:
Write a kids educational video script.

Topic: "{topic}"
Audience age: {age} years old
Number of scenes: {scenes}

Rules:
- HOOK FIRST: Scene 1 must open with something that grabs attention instantly — a surprising fact, a mystery, or a "did you know?" that makes kids curious. No generic greetings.
- Use very simple words and short sentences. Warm, cheerful, encouraging tone.
- Each scene's narration is 2 to 3 short sentences (about 15 seconds when read aloud).
- The middle scenes each teach ONE simple, TRUE fact. Do not invent facts.
- Include one "can you guess?" moment to keep kids engaged.
- The last scene gives a quick fun recap and says goodbye.
- The friendly mascot is a fox named Sunny. Use him as a guide in some scenes.
- image_prompt: describe ONLY what to draw, one concrete visual scene, no text in the picture. If Sunny appears, write "Sunny".
- speaker: use "narrator" for all scenes.
- mood: one of "cheerful", "curious", "excited", "warm"

Reply with JSON in exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "catchy YouTube title under 70 characters",
  "description": "2-3 sentence YouTube description",
  "tags": ["kids", "learning", "..."],
  "scenes": [
    {"narration": "...", "image_prompt": "...", "speaker": "narrator", "mood": "cheerful"}
  ]
}
